name: OAI.PiExponent.mem_realWeightedSimplex
prettyType:
∀ {d : ℕ} {w : Fin d → ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin d), 0 < w i) →
    ∀ {H : ℝ} {a : Fin d → ℕ}, a ∈ OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex w H ↔ ∑ i, w i * ↑(a i) ≤ H

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.column_mem_iff
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {w0 H : ℝ} {w : Fin m → ℝ},
  0 < w0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < w i) →
      ∀ (a : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ),
        a ∈ OAI.PiExponent.realWeightedSimplex (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.columnWeights w0 w) H ↔
          w0 * ↑(a 0) + ∑ i, w i * ↑(a i.succ) ≤ H

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.column_weight_le
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {w0 H : ℝ} {w : Fin m → ℝ},
  0 < w0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < w i) →
      ∀ (c : OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Column w0 w H), w0 * ↑(↑c 0) + ∑ i, w i * ↑(↑c i.succ) ≤ H

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.gaussian_norm_one_le
prettyType: ∀ (z : GaussianInt), z ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ ‖GaussianInt.toComplex z‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.gaussian_det_norm_one_le
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι GaussianInt),
  A.det ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ ‖(A.map ⇑GaussianInt.toComplex).det‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.det_row_column_scale
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r c : ι → ℂ),
  (Matrix.det fun i j => r i * (c j * A i j)) = ((∏ i, r i) * ∏ j, c j) * A.det

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_det_norm_bound
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι GaussianInt)
  (r c : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < c i) →
      A.det ≠ 0 →
        (B.map ⇑GaussianInt.toComplex = fun i j => ↑(r i) * (↑(c j) * A i j)) → 1 ≤ ((∏ i, r i) * ∏ j, c j) * ‖A.det‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_det_log_bound
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι GaussianInt)
  (r c : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < c i) →
      A.det ≠ 0 →
        (B.map ⇑GaussianInt.toComplex = fun i j => ↑(r i) * (↑(c j) * A i j)) →
          -∑ i, Real.log (r i) - ∑ j, Real.log (c j) ≤ Real.log ‖A.det‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_det_log_bound_of_entries
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r c : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < c i) →
      A.det ≠ 0 →
        (∀ (i j : ι), ↑(r i) * (↑(c j) * A i j) ∈ GaussianInt.toComplex.range) →
          -∑ i, Real.log (r i) - ∑ j, Real.log (c j) ≤ Real.log ‖A.det‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.Arithmetic.cleared_det_log_bound_with_denominator
prettyType:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r c : ι → ℝ) (D : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 < r i) →
      (∀ (i : ι), 0 < c i) →
        A.det ≠ 0 →
          (∀ (i j : ι), ↑D * ↑(r i) * (↑(c j) * A i j) ∈ GaussianInt.toComplex.range) →
            -↑(Fintype.card ι) * Real.log D - ∑ i, Real.log (r i) - ∑ j, Real.log (c j) ≤ Real.log ‖A.det‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale_pos
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {q : Fin m → ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < q i) → ∀ (a : Fin m → ℕ), 0 < OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale q a

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowScale_pos
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {q : Fin m → ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < q i) → ∀ (b : Fin m → ℕ), 0 < OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowScale q b

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.denominator_pos
prettyType: ∀ {m : ℕ} (q T : Fin m → ℕ) (H : ℝ), 0 < OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.denominator q T H

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.log_columnScale
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {q : Fin m → ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < q i) →
    ∀ (a : Fin m → ℕ), Real.log (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale q a) = ∑ i, ↑(a i) * Real.log ↑(q i)

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.log_rowScale
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {q : Fin m → ℕ},
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < q i) →
    ∀ (b : Fin m → ℕ), Real.log (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowScale q b) = -∑ i, ↑(b i) * Real.log ↑(q i)

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.ceil_log_weight_pos
prettyType: ∀ {q : ℕ}, 2 ≤ q → 0 < ↑⌈Real.log ↑q⌉₊

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.column_coordinate_le_floor
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} {w0 H : ℝ} {w : Fin m → ℝ},
  0 < w0 →
    (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < w i) →
      ∀ (c : OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Column w0 w H) (i : Fin m), ↑c i.succ ≤ ⌊H / w i⌋₊

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor_entries_gaussian
prettyType:
∀ {m K : ℕ} {w0 v0 θ F H : ℝ} (p : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
    0 < w0 →
      ∀
        (selection :
          OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H →
            OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Column w0 (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H)
        (ρ σ : OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H),
        ↑(OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.denominator q (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.truncationOrders q F v0) H) *
              ↑(OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowScale q fun i => ↑ρ.2 i.succ) *
            (↑(OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale q fun i => ↑(selection σ) i.succ) *
              OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection ρ σ) ∈
          GaussianInt.toComplex.range

name: solution
prettyType:
∀ {m K : ℕ} {w0 v0 θ F H : ℝ} (p : Fin m → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 2 ≤ q i) →
    0 < w0 →
      ∀
        (selection :
          OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H →
            OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Column w0 (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q) H),
        (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection).det ≠ 0 →
          -↑(Fintype.card
                        (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.Row K v0 θ (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.logWeights q)
                          H)) *
                  Real.log
                    (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.denominator q
                      (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.truncationOrders q F v0) H) -
                OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnCost q selection +
              OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowCost K v0 θ q H ≤
            Real.log ‖(OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.selectedMinor K w0 v0 θ F H p q selection).det‖

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale.eq_1
prettyType: ∀ {m : ℕ} (q a : Fin m → ℕ), OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale q a = ∏ i, ↑(q i) ^ a i

name: OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowScale.eq_1
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (q b : Fin m → ℕ),
  OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.rowScale q b = (OAI.PiExponent.MatrixArithmetic.columnScale q b)⁻¹
